correctness.rationale: The root-row decomposition is exhaustive: root absent forces each leaf row to equal the selected leaf subset; root alone forces nonempty leaf rows; root plus nonempty A forces A in every leaf row with root/remaining leaves free. For a leaf permutation of cycle type lambda, an invariant source-cycle representative row has 1+sum_j gcd(ell_i,ell_j) target orbits, giving the three displayed fixed-point contributions. Burnside weighted by 1/z_lambda proves the partition sum for all m>=2. Independent direct enumeration at m=2 gives 89 labelled relations; exact rational partition sums reproduce 50,940,53170,9968880,6472894706 for m=2..6.
